title: Lockfile (kiln.lock)
description: Which version of which package a project uses. It locks versions, not the environment: nothing in it depends on the operating system, compiler or build settings of the machine that wrote it, so developers on different platforms share one file and a rewrite by anyone gives the same bytes for the same versions. Each machine works out for itself how to obtain a binary for the locked versions. Platform-specific dependencies (dependencies restricted with 'platforms') are locked for every platform.

content-hash.description: Hash of the require/require-dev sections of kiln.json; detects a stale lock.

packages.description: Every package of the dependency graph for every platform, dependencies first.

commit.description: The commit the registry pinned for this version when the lock was written. If the registry later reports a different one, the tag was moved or the version republished, and install refuses. Absent where the registry pins nothing.

requires.description: The packages this one depends on (for readers of the lock; the pinned versions fully determine them).
